mostWorthwhile.text: Following filtering and recovery was most worthwhile: it showed that useful substances enter the filtered fluid and then return to the blood.

leastWorthwhile.text: Fitting the ureters was straightforward, but the result's picture description didn't show much change.

surprise.text: I was surprised that the filter lets useful glucose and water through along with wastes, rather than picking out only wastes.

arbitrary.text: Nothing felt particularly arbitrary; the organ fittings had a clear purpose, even if the ureter fitting was visually underexplained.

continue.text: I might continue: following the fluid from filtering through recovery to the bladder made the system understandable, though the fitting steps were less engaging.
